comments.body: Log the dropped item before shifting.

overallComment: Approved with one note about dropped items.

questions.question: What happens to the dropped item when the queue is full?
questions.answer: When `queue.length >= limit`, `enqueue` removes the oldest item with `queue.shift()` and discards the return value. It is not passed to a handler or returned to the caller; after that, the new item is appended. Any cleanup or notification for the dropped item is absent, and whether that is intended is unknown.
